summaries.summary: The image presents a graph called the 'Taylor Bathtub' illustrating the historical course of market dynamics, showing how the 'formal part of value creation' (Solution: machine) and the 'dynamic part of value creation' (Solution: man) have evolved over time. The graph highlights three eras: the Age of Crafts Manufacturing (1850/1900), the Age of Tayloristic Industry (1970/80), and the Age of Global Markets (today), with the formal part of value creation shifting from machine to increasingly complex systems.
key_facts: The 'formal part of value creation' is Solution: machine.
The 'dynamic part of value creation' is Solution: man.
The graph spans three historical eras: Age of Crafts Manufacturing (1850/1900), Age of Tayloristic Industry (1970/80), and Age of Global Markets (today).
